description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter with +1/+1 counter(s) due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
When Herd Baloth enters, it triggers, creating a creature token that enters with +1/+1 counter(s) due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting +1/+1 counter(s) on Herd Baloth
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters with +1/+1 counter(s) due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat from step 3.
